title: Dirty Harry
tagline: One bite in. Then the alarm.
about: A San Francisco inspector with a .44 Magnum and no time for the rule book hunts a sniper who calls himself Scorpio.
cue: Serve the hot dogs when Harry orders the usual and clocks the tan Ford outside the bank.
faces: SIX SHOTS OR FIVE JALAPEÑO POPPERS

Harry throws his badge in the water. Ghirardelli hot fudge, vanilla, toasted almonds.
